## Education

- **Ph.D., Economics**, University of California, Davis, 2013. Dissertation: “Three Essays on Tariff Pass-through.”
- **M.A., Economics**, Korea University, 2008. Thesis: “The Average Cost Share Equilibrium in an Economy with Information Goods Production.”
- **B.A., Economics**, Kyung Hee University, 2006, Summa Cum Laude.

## Research and teaching fields

International Trade (primary); Industrial Organization (secondary).
